  }))

  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "bank"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "jkbms" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name == "mos_temp" or r.name == "temp1" or r.name == "temp2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.bank == "a" or r.bank == "b")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r._value,
      series: (if r.bank == "a" then "A " else "B ") +
        (if r.name == "mos_temp" then "MOS" else if r.name == "temp1" then "T1" else "T2"),
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r._value,
      cell: "A" + r.cell,

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "soc_estimate" and r._field == "value" and r.name == "soc_est")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.bank == "a" or r.bank == "b")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value:
        if r.source == "track" then 0.0
        else if r.source == "coast_jk" then 1.0
        else if r.source == "coast_inverters" then 2.0
        else if r.source == "held" then 3.0
        else if r.source == "full_anchor" then 4.0
        else if r.source == "empty_anchor" then 5.0
        else -1.0,
      series: if r.bank == "a" then "Bank A" else "Bank B",
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
